title: Pasanga 2
desc: Kavin and Naina are expelled from several schools due to their hyperactive behaviour. Their frustrated parents accidentally meet Thamizh, a psychiatrist, who becomes a saviour for their children.

title: Singaravelan
desc: Velan's mother tells him to find his cousin, Sumathi, who lives in the city and marry her. Velan sets out to find her with the help of a childhood photograph.

title: Sigappu Thali
desc: Sadayan does errands for his fellow villagers and lives off their generosity. Soon, a series of circumstances compels him to help Kalamani, the daughter of the head of the village.

title: Geethanjali
desc: A scriptwriter moves into a luxurious apartment, only to be haunted by the vengeful ghost of a woman seeking justice for her mysterious death.

title: Jallikattu Kaalai
desc: Gopalkrishnan, an ordinary mill worker, falls in love with the mill owner's daughter. However, a vicious landlord causes a stir in their lives.
